acceptance: Require public BFF /readyz and /bff/version HTTP 200 and capture the actually served BFF revision.
Require exact equality among served FE SHA, served BFF SHA, pair ID, deployment manifest, Agora v1.13 compatibility manifest, and independently reviewed source commits.
Run AGORA-L12-REAL-VERIFIER-20260808 against hosted dev and require the correlated chain and all negative controls to pass.
Restart the BFF through governed dev authority and prove the same durable records and exact pair remain readable afterward.
Prove live mode, strict fallback, no embedded token, read-only profile, real writes false, stub writes false, unauthorized failures, and governed write rejection.
Reject stale, historical, fallback, local-only, self-attested, unreviewed, or manifest-only evidence.
On any failure, keep or restore the last accepted exact pair and leave the candidate unaccepted.
